picks.name: Oysters 101
picks.description: Flying Fish's crash course in all things bivalve — how to shuck, slurp, and tell your Kumamotos from your Shigokus, with plenty to taste along the way. A briny, hands-on way to start the week.

picks.name: 90 Day Fiancé Tell-All
picks.description: Jackie's throws a rowdy 21+ watch party for the 90 Day Fiancé Tell-All — the messiest night on reality TV, best experienced with a room full of fellow obsessives. Come for the drama, stay for the group gasps.

picks.name: El Grito Portland
picks.description: Portland's biggest ¡Grito! rings in Mexican Independence and Hispanic Heritage Month at the Moda Center — free, all day, and packed with music, dance, food, and family activities. A joyful kickoff to the celebration.

picks.name: Swift Watch
picks.description: September's magic hour: thousands of Vaux's swifts spiral into the chimney at Holy Trinity Church (or other locations around the metro area) at dusk before roosting for the night. Bring a blanket, watch these tiny majestic birds turn the sky into a dancing vortex. Please be respectful of the birds and the neighbors.

picks.name: PDX Fried Chicken Week
picks.description: A week-long, citywide excuse to eat fried chicken — participating spots serve $10 specials Sept 14–20, from classic buckets to Nashville-hot and Korean-style. Pick a new place each day.

picks.name: Li'l Coffee Shop of Horrors
picks.description: Geek Week takes over Sinister Coffee & Creamery with a playful Little Shop of Horrors–themed night — spooky sweets, themed drinks, and campy fun. A weird, sugary midweek treat.

picks.name: DJ George the Mixologist
picks.description: Director Park's downtown plaza gets a free midday soundtrack from DJ George the Mixologist. Grab lunch nearby, post up in the sun, and let the beats carry the afternoon.

picks.name: Fire vs. Phoenix Mercury
picks.description: Portland's brand-new WNBA team, the Fire, hosts the Phoenix Mercury at the Moda Center. Catch pro women's basketball in its inaugural PDX season — the crowd energy alone is worth the ticket.

picks.name: 7th Annual Elktoberfest
picks.description: The Vancouver Elks throw a free, family-friendly Oktoberfest across the river — brats, brews, live music, and games. An easy, low-key way to kick off Oktoberfest season.

picks.name: Gregory Alan Isakov + Oregon Symphony
picks.description: The beloved Colorado folk songwriter plays with the full Oregon Symphony behind him at the Schnitzer — lush, cinematic, and made for a big hall. One of the prettiest shows of the season.

picks.name: Belmont Street Fair
picks.description: SE Belmont shuts down for one of Portland's weirdest, most beloved street fairs — local vendors, live music, art, and peak people-watching. Free, all day, unmistakably Portland.

picks.name: Oktoberfest at Steeplejack
picks.description: Steeplejack Brewing throws a free Oktoberfest at its NE Broadway taproom — house brews, German eats, and a festive fall crowd well into the evening. Prost!

picks.name: Apple Festival
picks.description: Tryon Life Community Farm celebrates the harvest with fresh-pressed cider, live music, farm tours, and hands-on fall fun tucked into the woods off Boones Ferry. A cozy, family-friendly Sunday.

picks.name: The Front Bottoms
picks.description: The Jersey emo-folk favorites bring their "11 Years of Back On Top" tour to Revolution Hall — singalong anthems and rowdy, heart-on-sleeve energy. A loud, cathartic way to close the week.
